description:
Bridge the `fsharp-extractor` output into `CatseyeAST.t`.

Files
- `src/ocaml/lib/catseye_ast/fsharp_mapper.ml` — mirrors the structure of `ocaml_mapper.ml`. Reads the XML wire format from extractor stdout, walks it, produces `Types.t`. Focus on:
  - `SynModuleDecl` → `item` (`Let`, `Type`, `Module`).
  - `SynBinding` → `expr` (`ELet`, `EFn` for `let f x = ...`).
  - `SynPat` → `pattern` (`PVar`, `PDiscard`, `PTuple`, `PList`, `PAlias`, `PType`).
  - `SynExpr` → `expr` (`EApp`, `EIf`, `ECase`, `EVar`, `ELiteral`, `EBinOp`, `EUnOp`, `EFieldAccess`, `ERecord`, `EList`, `ETuple`, `ETryCatchFinally`).
  - `SynType` → `typ` (`TVar`, `TFn`, `TList`, `TTuple`, `TRecord`).
- `src/ocaml/lib/catseye_ast/fsharp_plugin.ml` — `Language_plugin.t` descriptor (see catseye-9mh.6 for the taint lists). `parse_file` shells out to the extractor (path lookup honors `CATSEYE_FSHARP_EXTRACTOR` env var, then `nix build` output, then `PATH`).
- Update `src/ocaml/lib/catseye_ast/dune` to include both new modules.

Decisions
- Position info: use FCS's `(file, startLine, startCol, endLine, endCol)` ranges. Map to `Position.t` / `range` like `ocaml_mapper.ml` does.
- Error handling: on extractor failure, return `PE.parse_error` with a useful message (don't silently fall back to an empty AST).
- Comments / trivia: ignore for now (F# has `SynExpr.Quote` for quotations, but we don't need them for the first slice).

Acceptance
- Mapper handles a representative fixture file end-to-end.
- Plugin descriptor has the correct extensions (`.fs`, `.fsx`, `.fsi`), manifest files (`*.fsproj`, `paket.dependencies`), and capability flags (`supports_ast_bridge = true`, `supports_il_cfg = true`).
- A short note in the mapper header documents the wire-format version it consumes (so future extractor changes know to bump a version stamp).

Blocked by: catseye-9mh.3.
Worktree: `catseye-9mh.4/fsharp-plugin-mapper`.
title: Add F# plugin + mapper to catseye_ast
